description: We are pleased to invite you to a Meet & Greet with Senator Janice Marchman and Congressman Joe Neguse. Join us for this opportunity to hear updates from Senator Marchman about the campaign trail, the legislative session, and how she plans to make Colorado a place we can afford to live.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Janice Marchman for Colorado Senate
title: Sugarloaf Meet + Greet — Janice Marchman for Colorado State Senate
